# Basalt

`basalt.lua` is the unmodified official Basalt 2.5 minified bundle from
[Pyroxenium/Basalt2](https://github.com/Pyroxenium/Basalt2), commit
`4372b70c0d34cf0cc2687b1f67776e1de025c888`. It reports `2.5.0-dev`.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pyroxenium/Basalt2/4372b70c0d34cf0cc2687b1f67776e1de025c888/bundle/basalt.min.lua

SHA-256: `e015ea55e952435410d6b9f5cb53dd8628ab0e16c3bb51fd39fea050e59a854b`

The [official documentation](https://basalt.madefor.cc/2.5/) identifies Basalt as
MIT licensed, copyright 2025 Robert Jelic. Its license accompanies the bundle.
Keep third-party code unchanged; CivCraft's adapter and layouts follow this
repository's own formatting and lint rules.
